messages:
maria: quick FYI — around 12:04 UTC we saw a spike of KMS decrypt failures (throttling) for hosted-api in us-west-2, a bunch of customer requests returned 500s
kevin: seeing the alert too. graph: kms.decrypt_errors went from ~0 to ~120 in 2m, p95 latency for kms calls jumped to 800ms
deploy-bot: ALERT: service=hosted-api region=us-west-2 metric=kms-decrypt-failure rate=4.8% window=2m\sre-oncall: impact: some requests fell back to cached DEK (graceful path) but others retried and hit timeout. We had ~30 user-facing 500s in that window\maria: root cause unknown yet — could be KMS throttling or a client-side retry stampede. Not seeing any IAM DENY logs, so not RBAC\kevin: checked KMS metrics in AWS console — requests spiked due to bursty onboarding job + simultaneous user traffic. Key requests QPS briefly exceeded the key's soft limit. KMS returned ThrottlingException and introduced delays\ashley: current client config (from runtime):
```
KMS_BACKOFF_BASE_MS=200
KMS_BACKOFF_MAX_MS=2000
KMS_BACKOFF_JITTER=true
DEK_CACHE_TTL=30s
DEK_CACHE_SIZE=500
```
ashley: note DEK cache TTL is only 30s; decrypt-heavy endpoints can rapidly evict and re-request DEKs, amplifying KMS load\maria: proposal: increase DEK_CACHE_TTL to 5m for hosted tier, add randomized exponential backoff with bigger cap, and add a local circuit-breaker that serves cached DEK even if slightly stale when KMS is failing (soft-fail route)\kevin: +1. Also add request deduping for identical envelope decrypts within short windows, and pre-warm frequently used keys during deploys to avoid cold spikes. For AWS KMS we can request increase to account-level quotas but better to reduce per-request footprint\sre-oncall: we should also improve alerting — right now the only alert was error rate; add a KMS-specific throttle alert and a run rate metric per key id\maria: audit logs: CloudTrail shows the throttles but the audit trail doesn't indicate a principal spike — need to map which service instances generated the bursts (tagging/trace ids). We should correlate with deploys/orchestrations\ashley: action items I'll take: update runbook, bump DEK_CACHE_TTL to 5m in staging, add circuit-breaker flip in feature flag, and add dedupe middleware. Will open PRs and test in staging\kevin: I'll file a request to AWS support asking for quota guidance and pre-warm recommendation. Also instrument per-key QPS in our observability (prometheus label key_id)\maria: short-term mitigation: enable soft-fail cached DEK path for 30m today via feature flag to reduce user-visible errors. Long-term: change default cache TTL + dedupe + improved backoff + per-key metrics + runbook updates\sre-oncall: tagging assignments: ashley -> runbook + PR, kevin -> AWS ticket + metrics, maria -> deploy feature flag and coordinate canary. I'll follow up after first PR test. :thumbsup:
notes: near-miss: user impact limited but exposed several op gaps: small DEK TTL, retry pattern, missing per-key telemetry
